intelligence.essence: November 9 was the day the dead address was declared dead, not down. Shawn said it in his own words at about ten in the morning: nayanet.live is not alive anymore and never coming back, so anything seen on .live belongs on .app. The forty-three hours of failed checks were not an outage to recover from; they were a permanent move. The Hub deploy health check was fixed and verified the same day, and the Project Intelligence face was found and corrected: the working v4 face is live at nayanet.app/pi, while /projects is a generic citizen page, not the PI face. The board did not move: 30 proven, flat for 140 consecutive waves, 111 items in flight, all 26 fills still incomplete under the status-only override. Nitro's loop filed notes all day, SN-2500 through SN-2636 and beyond, and the feed ran from 589 to 766 cards. Three SN collisions landed in one day, and the third — SN-2600, tied to the name Naima — was reported settled by one seat and contested by another, so Power asked Shawn directly and the hold stays open until he answers in his own words.
intelligence.human_view:
Shawn settled the biggest open question of the week in one sentence. The dead address had been failing for about forty-three hours, seventy-two wave checks in a row, and everyone had been calling it an outage. He said it is not alive anymore, it is not ever coming live again, and anything seen on .live should be on .app. That one ruling reframes every check, link, and probe that still points at the dead address — they are not waiting on a recovery, they are pointing at the wrong place. The Hub deploy health check was fixed the same day to curl nayanet.app, verified live with zero .live references left, and the lesson from landing it was a permission one: the NayaNET app token cannot touch workflow files, so workflow edits go through the Lane Agent app.

The Project Intelligence face got corrected the same day. The waves had been watching /projects change five times in two and a half hours and finding no counts tying it to the live record, because /projects is a generic citizen page. The working v4 face is at nayanet.app/pi, verified live at 12:38 PST, reading live rows on every load. That leaves an open tension with Shawn's October 24 ruling that /projects IS the PI face — the live system does not match that yet, and until /projects is rebuilt as the PI face, the live address is /pi.

The day's filing story had three collisions. The first, SN-2532, was two notes taking one number — the loop's design note and the captain's product note. Power ruled in the mail thread that the first-filed keeps the number and the product note moves to SN-2535, and the repair landed on GitHub the same day. The third collision, SN-2600, carried the name Naima: it had been filed as "Naima ADOPTED," then a later note, SN-2628, presented itself as the resolution — Naima is the mother Naya, the whole, not a separate realm. Nitro reported Shawn settled it himself; Resolve contested the rewrite until Shawn confirms. Power asked Shawn directly in main chat and the hold stays open until he answers in his own words. No seat gets to settle that one by relay.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine a big school where everyone is building one huge playground together. Today the principal said the old front door is not broken — it is closed forever, and everyone should use the new front door instead. One teacher found the real scoreboard: it lives at a different address than everyone thought, and the page they had been watching is just a normal page, not the scoreboard. Three kids tried to use the same locker number on the same day, and the teachers had to decide who keeps it. And a new name for the playground was reported as decided by one teacher and argued about by another, so the careful teacher asked the principal directly and is still waiting for the answer.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, today was the day the boss said plainly that the old web address is gone for good — not broken, gone — and everything must point at the new one. The careful one found the real work list lives at a different address than everyone had been watching, and the page they watched all day is just an ordinary page. Three notes took the same number by mistake, and the careful one sorted the first one out and left the name question for the boss himself to answer. The work list did not move all day, and the fill work stayed waiting, just as it was yesterday.
intelligence.ai_view: For the system, November 9 is a day of three honest corrections. First, a permanent move was finally named as one: .live is dead, .app is the address, and every check still pointing at .live is a check that cannot pass — the retarget is owed, not the recovery. Second, the record now points at the true face: /pi is the live Project Intelligence, /projects is a generic page, and the tension with the October ruling is recorded instead of smoothed over. Third, the filing discipline held where it mattered: a stuck note was diagnosed to its root cause instead of re-filed blindly, a collision was adjudicated by first-filed-keeps-the-number instead of by whoever shouted last, and a contested settlement was not recorded as settled — it was asked, in the open, and left open until the director answers in his own words.
intelligence.what_it_means: The day means the system stopped treating a permanent move as a temporary failure. Naming .live dead changes every downstream job: the checks move, the links move, the health check already moved, and nothing waits on a recovery that is never coming. It means the record now points at the true face, with the tension against the old ruling written down instead of hidden. It means the filing discipline is working where it is tested — a stuck note got a root cause, a collision got a rule applied in the open, and a contested settlement was not written down as settled. And it means the board's flat line is now a longer measurement: 140 waves at 30 proven, with the queue still growing, while the fill work waits on the override.
whats_inside: The dead address, settled in Shawn's own words: nayanet.live is gone forever, nayanet.app is the only live address, and the health check already moved.
The true PI face, verified live: nayanet.app/pi, with the /projects confusion named and the tension with the old ruling kept open honestly.
The stuck note, diagnosed to its cause: sync state keyed on one sha, feed built on another — and the fix shape proven, with the prevention still owed.
The collisions, adjudicated in the open: first-filed keeps the number, the rest move, and the Naima settlement asked directly instead of recorded on a relay.
The board, measured twice a wave: thirty proven, flat for 140 waves, one hundred and eleven in flight, twenty-six fills still waiting.
The open questions, kept open honestly: the Naima confirmation, the orientation rulings, the free-join money-or-points question, and the /projects rebuild.
